title: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation
author: Mo Xiang Tong Xiu
description: Wei Wuxian, the despised Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation, is resurrected in the body of a lunatic and forced into a second life. Reunited with his former childhood peer, the righteous Lan Wangji, the two must unravel a web of dark mysteries that bind their past and present together. This epic tale intertwines supernatural investigation, profound emotional drama, and martial arts mastery.
